description: Per-character battle-UI presentation settings: whether the character uses cursed or physical energy labels, which cursed-energy gauge skin to draw, and where the lock-on target cursor sits on screen.

ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export). Status_FindCharacterUIRow (retail 0x14ddf60) walks CharacterUIDataTables (DTM +0x470) and returns the row for a character's Id_CharacterUI; several callers use bCheckNone=true or fall back to defaults when missing.

CharacterEnergyType.simple: Whether the character's resource is cursed energy or a physical substitute.
CharacterEnergyType.technical: EGameCharacterEnergyType (uint8: None, Cursed, Physical, Invalid). Read as Physical (value 2) to switch HUD strings (BTL_HUD_LABEL_0632 vs 0631, 0711 vs 0710), to choose the command-list energy label/category and to set FGameCommandListActionCursedEnergyParameter::EnergyType. Missing UI row falls back to Cursed in callers that supply defaults. Export: 44 Cursed, 2 Physical.

CursedEnergyGaugeType.simple: Selects the cursed-energy gauge appearance/segment style for this character.
CursedEnergyGaugeType.technical: EGameCursedEnergyGaugeType (uint8: None, JujutsuSorcerers, CursedSpirits, Physical, CP_020, CP_110, Invalid). Passed to AGameWidgetManager::GetCursedEnergyGaugeParameter to obtain main/sub colors for battle HUD, command list and VS-enemy interval gauges. Battle button-guide setup also uses it to configure guide widgets; the fallback when no row exists is JujutsuSorcerers. Export: 22 JujutsuSorcerers, 20 CursedSpirits, 2 Physical, one each CP_020 and CP_110.

TargetCursorHeightRate.simple: Fraction of the target's screen height at which the lock-on cursor is drawn (measured up from the bottom).
TargetCursorHeightRate.technical: float (row +0x14), default 0.0 in the row constructor but 0.5 in callers when no row is found. UGameBattleTargetCursorWidget reads the target character's CharacterUI row, then sets Translation.Y = (Bottom - Top) * (1 - HeightRate) + Top of the target's screen bounds; Translation.X is the bounds center. Export values are 0.5 (44 rows) and 0.6 (2 rows). The field belongs to the target, not the player whose cursor is being drawn.

notes: Export contains 46 rows. The two Physical characters use both the Physical energy type and the Physical gauge skin; CP_020/CP_110 gauge skins are bespoke variants.
Row constructor defaults all three fields to None/None/0.0, but most consumers supply their own fallback (Cursed, JujutsuSorcerers, 0.5) when the row or field is missing.
Single table asset 'CharacterUIDataTable' loaded into DTM +0x470; no numbered shards or localization variants in the export.
Reconstructed source with cited retail RVAs; no claim about Blueprint-only consumers or byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Status_FindCharacterUIRow resolves the row for button-guide text and gauge selection.
Inline row lookup returns the gauge type for the battle HUD.
Command list reads energy type and gauge type for its own display.
Target cursor uses the target's TargetCursorHeightRate to position itself.
